scope: Corollary 6.19 (The grouped cylinder splice) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 99-100. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let C be a finite tiled cylinder of circumference comparable to n, with finite positive FK cap graphs drawn planarly at its rims. Its bottom has a flat mixed-color boundary near a specified flip-gap vertex s, and a second marked bottom point t at distance comparable to n. All tiles in the following charts are ordinary. Fix their shape and buffer constants first, then take n/r sufficiently large and r sufficiently large in tile units. There are finitely many endpoint boxes in the bulk near s, with distances from s, depths from the bottom, and mutual spacings between fixed positive multiples of r. Their radii are at 99 most δr, where δ > 0 is fixed sufficiently small. Each box has a disjoint ordinary bulk-annular buffer, of fixed relative width, within the scale-r half-disk. Choose c0 > 0 and C0 < ∞ so that these buffers lie strictly between radii c0r and C0r about s, with fixed positive margins. Their complement in this gap contains the clear two-arm splice layout of Lemma 6.18. Choose fixed 0 < c1 < c2 so that the s-centered half-disk of radius c2n is an injective flat cylinder chart. The half-sector collar between its tile-level cuts at c1n and c2n has a sufficiently large fixed ratio for Lemma 6.13. The t box, of radius at most δn, and the remote middle region lie outside the c2n chart with positive n-scale margins. The attached graphs at this chart and at every endpoint buffer satisfy Definition 6.12, with a fixed bound on all named bank classes and its residual-cap condition. In particular the graph outside the s chart attaches only at its outer radial cut and those named hubs. A regular bulk window before the t box and the middle contains a joining tube and a cleared corridor winding once between two distinct tube positions, as in Proposition 6.14. For each of two spaced flat openings on the c1n target cut, a cleared branch joins its outward ordinary neighborhood to the tube. The branch and winding buffers have fixed positive n-scale clearances from the conditioned regions and satisfy the permitted local-chart contract. Let D specify the edge states in the endpoint boxes, the t box, and the remote middle; consider any feasible value of these data. Let Rarm be the intersection of a short actual gap arm from s to radius c0r and a separate same-color actual radial traversal from radius C0r to radius c1n, both in the flat half-disk chart. Their supports avoid all the endpoint buffers. Choose a finite positive FK reference cap law that agrees with the cylinder law on the graph, odds, and deterministic wall portions through radius c2n, including the endpoint buffers, and whose exterior at that cut is permitted. Let Aref be its full actual gap arm from s to a fixed full cutoff of radius comparable to n and strictly beyond c1n, with a fixed buffer. Put pref := Pref(Aref). The cutoff separates s from the outer continuation of the reference chart, so trimming gives Aref ⊆ Rarm. Let E require an actual arm from s joined to a noncontractible actual cycle in the stated bulk window. There is c > 0 such that P(E | D) ≥ cP(Rarm | D) ≥ c2 pref. (6.26) For k mutually separated opposite-color marker-traversal requirements B1, . . . , Bk, with their full splice windows between radii 2C0r and c1n/2, one also has P  Rarm ∩ k \ j=1 Bj D   ≤ C(1 − c)k P(Rarm | D). (6.27) Here C = 1 is possible when every listed marker has its full window; the constant permits omission of boundedly many end markers. The constants depend on the fixed buffer choices and reference cutoff, but not on r, n, k or the values of D.
